critical_code_review_comments: Services.jsx applies grid span via both Tailwind class `md:col-span-${s.span}` and inline `style.gridColumn`. The dynamic class string will not be picked up by Tailwind JIT and is effectively dead code; the inline style is what works. Safe to remove the className to avoid confusion.

Navbar `nav-${l.label.toLowerCase()}` produces a data-testid containing the character ç (e.g. `nav-serviços`). Works in CSS selectors but is unusual; consider slugified ids (nav-servicos) for robustness.
Services.jsx line 71 has duplicate `mt-7` class on the price/CTA row (`pt-7 ... mt-7 mt-7`).
